name: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction and shipbuilding business in South Korea. The company offers architecture, housing, infrastructure, plant, and research and development services. It also provides shipbuilding services, such as warships, special purpose ships, and commercial ships. The company was founded in 1937 and is based in Busan, South Korea. HJ Shipbuilding & Construction Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Echo Prime Marine Pacific Co., Ltd.
